sentences.zh: 忠義九

translations.literal: Loyal and Righteous 9
translations.idiomatic: Loyal and Righteous 9

sentences.zh: 宗室奕功札隆阿等覺羅清廉等松林文炘等

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yigong, Zhalong'a, and others; Aisin Gioro Qinglian and others; Songlin, Wen Xin, and others
translations.idiomatic: Yigong of the imperial clan, Zhalong'a and others, Qinglian of the Aisin Gioro line, Songlin, Wen Xin, and others

sentences.zh: 崇壽韓紹徽韓培森馬鍾祺董瀚譚昌祺莊禮本馮福疇

translations.literal: Chongshou, Han Shaohui, Han Peisen, Ma Zhongqi, Dong Han, Tan Changqi, Zhuang Liben, Feng Fuchou
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou, Han Shaohui, Han Peisen, Ma Zhongqi, Dong Han, Tan Changqi, Zhuang Liben, and Feng Fuchou

sentences.zh: 宮玉森景善等宋春華馬福祿楊福同

translations.literal: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua, Ma Fulu, Yang Futong
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, Jingshan, and others; Song Chunhua, Ma Fulu, and Yang Futong

sentences.zh: 吳德潚子仲韜成肇麟

translations.literal: Wu Desi and his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin
translations.idiomatic: Wu Desi and his son Zhongtao; Cheng Zhaolin

sentences.zh: 宗室奕功，歷官奉宸苑卿，至御前侍衛。

translations.literal: Imperial clansman Yigong successively served as Director of the Imperial Parks and rose to imperial bodyguard before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansman Yigong served in turn as Director of the Imperial Parks and eventually as an imperial bodyguard in attendance.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十六年，拳匪肇禍，各國聯軍破京都，德宗奉孝欽顯皇后西狩，奕功以世受國恩，未能隨扈，引火自焚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Guangxu the Boxers began the calamity; the allied armies of the powers broke the capital; Emperor Dezong escorted Empress Dowager Xiaojin the Manifest west on tour; Yigong, having received the state's grace through generations, could not follow the imperial retinue, and set himself afire.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26 the Boxer uprising erupted, the allied armies of the foreign powers took the capital, and Emperor Guangxu led Empress Dowager Cixi west in flight. Yigong, who had long enjoyed the dynasty's favor, was unable to join the imperial flight and burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 妻祥佳氏、子載捷等，闔家投井殉節。

translations.literal: His wife, Lady Xiangjia, his son Zaijie, and the rest of the household threw themselves into a well and died for their integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Xiangjia, his son Zaijie, and the entire household cast themselves into a well and perished in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 先後被難者，宗室有奉恩將軍札隆阿，子樸誠等；

translations.literal: Among those who met calamity in succession, of the imperial clan there were Enfeoffed General Zhalong'a and his son Pucheng and others;
translations.idiomatic: Among those who perished in the turmoil were, from the imperial clan, Enfeoffed General Zhalong'a and his son Pucheng, among others;

sentences.zh: 奉恩將軍緝禦，子培善，孫存德、存厚等；

translations.literal: Enfeoffed General Jiyu, his son Peishan, his grandsons Cunde and Cunhou and others;
translations.idiomatic: Enfeoffed General Jiyu, his son Peishan, and his grandsons Cunde and Cunhou, among others;

sentences.zh: 文舉人恩煦，子繼勳、懋勳，從子啟勳、世勳等；

translations.literal: the licentiate in letters Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, his nephews Qixun and Shixun and others;
translations.idiomatic: the licentiate Enxu, his sons Jixun and Maoxun, and his nephews Qixun and Shixun, among others;

sentences.zh: 掌江西道監察御史德籓，戶部員外郎恩斝，戶部主事謹善，宗人府經歷訥欽，頭等侍衛德潤，帶隊官鈺璋，及奕鑫、載袍、恕誠、聯德、恩溥、鬆達、善章、國文、松根、景璋、承惠、和桂、鳳喜、吉辰、海明，覺羅有清廉、年瑞、德潤、榮綿。

translations.literal: the supervising censor in charge of the Jiangxi circuit Defan, the Ministry of Revenue vice director Enjia, the Ministry of Revenue secretary Jinshan, the Imperial Clan Court clerk Neqin, first-rank bodyguard Derun, detachment officer Yuzhang, and Yixin, Zaipao, Shucheng, Liande, Enpu, Songda, Shanzhang, Guowen, Songgen, Jingzhang, Chenghui, He Gui, Fengxi, Jichen, and Haiming; among the Aisin Gioro were Qinglian, Nianrui, Derun, and Rongmian.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Defan of the Jiangxi circuit, Vice Director Enjia of the Ministry of Revenue, Secretary Jinshan of the same ministry, Imperial Clan Court clerk Neqin, first-rank bodyguard Derun, detachment officer Yuzhang, and Yixin, Zaipao, Shucheng, Liande, Enpu, Songda, Shanzhang, Guowen, Songgen, Jingzhang, Chenghui, He Gui, Fengxi, Jichen, and Haiming; among the Aisin Gioro lineage were Qinglian, Nianrui, Derun, and Rongmian.

sentences.zh: 松林，巴雅爾氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Songlin, of the Bayar clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Songlin, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and member of the Bayar clan,

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式累擢給事中。

translations.literal: rose from clerk by successive promotions to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: rose from the clerk corps through successive promotions to supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 出知臨安府，升雲南糧儲道，晉山東按察使、布政使。

translations.literal: went out to serve as prefect of Lin'an, was promoted to grain intendant of Yunnan, and advanced to Shandong surveillance commissioner and provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Lin'an, was promoted to Yunnan grain intendant, and later became Shandong surveillance commissioner and provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 內擢順天府府尹，病解任，起為內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was selected within the capital to be metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, resigned on illness, and was recalled as a Hanlin reader in the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was brought into the capital as metropolitan prefect of Shuntian, retired on account of illness, and was later recalled as a reader-attendant in the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 聯軍犯京師，分守東直門，親指揮砲火中，抵禦甚力。

translations.literal: When the allied armies attacked the capital he was assigned to hold Dongzhimen and personally directed amid gunfire, resisting with great force.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies assaulted the capital he was assigned to defend Dongzhimen and personally directed the defense under heavy fire, fighting with great determination.

sentences.zh: 俄中砲死，屍不可辨。

translations.literal: Soon he was struck by artillery and died; his corpse could not be identified.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon killed by artillery fire, and his body could no longer be identified.

translations.idiomatic: At Qihuamen was Guard Captain Lianrui.

sentences.zh: 西直門有養育兵烏什哈，閒散全桂。

translations.idiomatic: At Xizhimen were stipend soldier Wushiha and idle bannerman Quangui.

translations.idiomatic: At Fuchengmen were Ao'erbu and Zhongshan.

translations.idiomatic: At Yongdingmen were idle bannermen Changtai, Yutai, and Chunxiang.

translations.literal: At Zhengyangmen were idle bannermen Qinglin, Kuilian, and Desheng.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhengyangmen were idle bannermen Qinglin, Kuilian, and Desheng.

translations.idiomatic: At Daqingmen was vanguard Yuxing.

translations.idiomatic: At the Meridian Gate were Deputy Guard Commandant Fengling, vanguards Chongxiang and Guifeng, and guards Yushou and Dekai.

translations.idiomatic: At Dong'anmen were Common Associate Commandant Songshou, Infantry Captain Wentong, and squad leader Yanshou.

translations.idiomatic: At Xi'anmen were stipend soldiers Yongshun and Defu.

sentences.zh: 西華門有馬甲春明。

translations.literal: At Xihuamen was armored cavalryman Chunming.
translations.idiomatic: At Xihuamen was armored cavalryman Chunming.

sentences.zh: 地安門有虎神營營總昆明，副護軍參領恆謙，護軍營管理祥瑞，護軍隊官凌魁，隊長彥祿，護軍常瑞、薩圖布、永安、常山、雙壽、興斌，馬甲文海、福山，養育兵崇恩、全苓、順喜、閒散德祥。

sentences.zh: 紫禁城內有護軍參領海忠，親軍校文玉。

translations.literal: Within the Forbidden City were guard commandant Haizhong and personal guard captain Wenyu.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Forbidden City were Guard Commandant Haizhong and Personal Guard Captain Wenyu.

sentences.zh: 守陴者有世管佐領德潤，馬甲錫秀。

translations.literal: Those who held the battlements included hereditary associate commandant Derun and armored cavalryman Xixiu.
translations.idiomatic: Those who defended the ramparts included Hereditary Associate Commandant Derun and armored cavalryman Xixiu.

sentences.zh: 死事者：寧壽宮員外郎誠年、筆帖式福臻在內值宿，七月二十一日巳刻，聞兩宮西狩，即赴各殿封鎖，至斂禧門外值房投井死。

translations.literal: Those who died in the line of duty: Ningshou Palace vice director Chengnian and clerk Fuzhen were on interior night duty; on the twenty-first day of the seventh month at the si hour, hearing that the two palaces had gone west on tour, they at once went to seal the various halls and threw themselves into a well at the duty room outside the Gate of Accumulated Joy.
translations.idiomatic: Among those who died in service were Ningshou Palace Vice Director Chengnian and Clerk Fuzhen, who were on night duty inside the palace. On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, at the si hour, upon hearing that the emperor and empress dowager had fled west, they went at once to seal the palace halls and then cast themselves into a well at the duty room outside the Gate of Accumulated Joy.

sentences.zh: 太廟五品官富亮，值班上香，洋兵突進，拒之，槍死。

translations.literal: Imperial Ancestral Temple fifth-rank officer Fuliang, on duty to offer incense, when foreign soldiers burst in resisted them and was shot dead.
translations.idiomatic: Fuliang, a fifth-rank officer of the Imperial Ancestral Temple who was on duty to offer incense, resisted when foreign troops burst in and was shot dead.

sentences.zh: 織工張繼福，在綺華館被戕。

translations.literal: Weaver Zhang Jifu was killed at the Qihua Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The weaver Zhang Jifu was slain at the Qihua Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 左營參將王長廕守署不去，以獨力難持，投井死。

translations.literal: Left Camp brigade general Wang Changyin held the yamen and would not leave; finding himself unable to hold out alone, he threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade General Wang Changyin of the Left Camp refused to abandon his headquarters; seeing that he could not hold out alone, he threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 護軍連升值班端門；

translations.literal: Guard Liansheng was on duty at Duanmen;
translations.idiomatic: Guard Liansheng was on duty at Duanmen;

sentences.zh: 護軍崇連，神機營呈遞公事步軍校賡音布、常福、勝喜，領催雙喜，馬甲存林、恩明，外委孫國瑞，技勇兵常有、隆祥、萬昭，均在廳值班；

translations.literal: guard Chonglian, Shenji Camp infantry captains Gengyinbu, Changfu, and Shengxi who presented official documents, squad leader Shuangxi, armored cavalrymen Cunlin and Enming, sub-officer Sun Guorui, and skilled braves Changyou, Longxiang, and Wanzhao were all on duty in the hall;
translations.idiomatic: Guard Chonglian, Shenji Camp Infantry Captains Gengyinbu, Changfu, and Shengxi who handled official dispatches, squad leader Shuangxi, armored cavalrymen Cunlin and Enming, sub-officer Sun Guorui, and skilled braves Changyou, Longxiang, and Wanzhao were all on hall duty;

sentences.zh: 領催榮鈐，養育兵定成，隊兵布興泰，均看守軍庫；

translations.literal: squad leader Rongqian, stipend soldier Dingcheng, and company soldier Buxingtai were all guarding the arsenal;
translations.idiomatic: squad leader Rongqian, stipend soldier Dingcheng, and company soldier Buxingtai were guarding the arsenal;

sentences.zh: 南城正指揮項同壽，在署辦公；

translations.literal: South City chief commander Xiang Tongshou was at his yamen attending to business;
translations.idiomatic: South City Chief Commander Xiang Tongshou was at his office;

sentences.zh: 戶部書吏高世祥，總理衙門供事沈鵬儀、徐伯興、洪瑞汶，均在署值班，與於難。

translations.literal: Ministry of Revenue clerk Gao Shixiang and Zongli Yamen attendants Shen Pengyi, Xu Boxing, and Hong Ruiwen were all on duty at their offices and perished in the calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue clerk Gao Shixiang and Zongli Yamen attendants Shen Pengyi, Xu Boxing, and Hong Ruiwen were all on duty at their offices and perished in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 在先陣亡者：把總李鍾山，外委李鍾林，七月十七日，在張家灣禦敵，不克，死。

translations.literal: Those who had fallen earlier in battle: platoon commander Li Zhongshan and sub-officer Li Zhonglin, on the seventeenth day of the seventh month at Zhangjiawan resisted the enemy, failed, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had fallen earlier included Platoon Commander Li Zhongshan and sub-officer Li Zhonglin, who on the seventeenth day of the seventh month fought the enemy at Zhangjiawan, were defeated, and died.

sentences.zh: 先後被難者：游擊王燮，五月二十五日在東便門彈壓拳匪，被戕，並毀其屍；

translations.literal: Among those who met calamity in succession: brigade commander Wang Xie, on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month at Dongbianmen suppressed the Boxers, was killed, and his corpse was destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: Among those who perished in the turmoil were Brigade Commander Wang Xie, who on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month suppressed Boxers at Dongbianmen, was killed, and his body was mutilated;

sentences.zh: 采育營部司楊光第，於閏八月二十九日聞洋兵至，衣冠坐營中，被槍死；

translations.literal: Caiyu Camp department officer Yang Guangdi, on the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary eighth month hearing that foreign soldiers had arrived, sat in full dress in the camp and was shot dead;
translations.idiomatic: Caiyu Camp department officer Yang Guangdi, on the twenty-ninth day of the intercalary eighth month upon hearing that foreign troops had arrived, sat in full official dress in the camp and was shot dead;

sentences.zh: 把總張進志擁護同死。

translations.literal: platoon commander Zhang Jinzhi shielded him and died with him.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon Commander Zhang Jinzhi shielded him and died at his side.

sentences.zh: 均經留京辦事大臣崑岡上聞，贈卹有差。

translations.literal: All were reported upward by the minister left in the capital to manage affairs, Kungang, and posthumous honors and pensions were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Kungang, the minister left in Beijing to manage affairs, reported all of them to the throne, and posthumous honors and pensions were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 崇壽，溫徹亨氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Chongshou, of the Wencheheng clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chongshou, a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner and member of the Wencheheng clan,

sentences.zh: 光緒十六年進士，入翰林，累擢翰林院侍讀。

translations.literal: became a jinshi in the sixteenth year of Guangxu, entered the Hanlin Academy, and was promoted in succession to Hanlin reader.
translations.idiomatic: passed the jinshi examination in Guangxu 16, entered the Hanlin Academy, and rose in succession to Hanlin reader.

sentences.zh: 變作時，不勝憂憤，仰藥死。

translations.literal: When the upheaval occurred he could not bear his grief and indignation and died by taking poison.
translations.idiomatic: When the crisis broke out he was overcome with grief and indignation and took poison to die.

sentences.zh: 詔以「見危授命」褒之，諡文貞。

translations.literal: An edict praised him with the phrase "meeting peril he gave his life," and he was given the posthumous title Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him with the words "he met peril and gave his life," and he was granted the posthumous title Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 韓紹徽，字筱珊，貴州貴陽人。

translations.literal: Han Shaohui, style Xiaoshan, was a native of Guiyang in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shaohui, styled Xiaoshan, was from Guiyang in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年進士，授主事，分刑部，勤於所職。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the twentieth year of Guangxu, was appointed a director, assigned to the Ministry of Punishments, and was diligent in his duties.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Guangxu 20, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Punishments, and was diligent in his work.

sentences.zh: 拳亂初起，嘗走同官，涕泣誓身殉。

translations.literal: When the Boxer turmoil first arose he once went among his colleagues in tears, vowing to give his body in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer uprising first broke out he went among his colleagues in tears, vowing to die for the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 七月二十一日，自經於陝西司司堂。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month he hanged himself in the main hall of the Shaanxi Bureau.

sentences.zh: 掌江西道御史韓培森，巡城積勞，城破，絕食死。

translations.literal: Supervising censor in charge of the Jiangxi circuit Han Peisen, worn out by accumulated labor in patrolling the city, when the city fell starved himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Censor Han Peisen of the Jiangxi circuit, worn out by long service patrolling the walls, starved himself to death when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 內閣中書堃厚，手書「見危授命」四字，與妻同縊死。

translations.literal: Grand Secretariat secretary Kun Hou wrote with his own hand the four characters "meeting peril, giving one's life," and hanged himself together with his wife.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretariat Secretary Kun Hou wrote with his own hand the four characters "meeting peril, giving one's life," and hanged himself together with his wife.

sentences.zh: 馬鍾祺，字維春，隸漢軍鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: Ma Zhongqi, style Weichun, was of the Hanjun Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhongqi, styled Weichun, belonged to the Hanjun Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 少為諸生，以襲一等子，例不得與試，授三等侍衛，擢二等，有文武才。

translations.literal: In youth he was a licentiate; by inheriting a first-class viscountcy he was by regulation barred from examinations, was appointed a third-rank bodyguard, was promoted to the second rank, and had both civil and military talent.
translations.idiomatic: In his youth he was a licentiate; having inherited a first-class viscountcy he was barred by regulation from the examinations, was appointed a third-rank bodyguard, was promoted to the second rank, and possessed both literary and military ability.

sentences.zh: 初服膺陸、王之學，繼參以程、硃、張、呂，不主一家。

translations.literal: At first he adhered to the learning of Lu and Wang, then blended in Cheng, Zhu, Zhang, and Lü, and did not adhere to a single school.
translations.idiomatic: He first embraced the learning of Lu Xiangshan and Wang Yangming, then drew also on Cheng Yi, Zhu Xi, Zhang Zai, and Lü Dalin, and did not commit himself to any one school alone.

sentences.zh: 為人伉爽有奇氣，慕孫白谷之為人，好與朝野賢士遊，與語或不合，輒哦詩亂之，以此得狂名。

translations.literal: As a man he was bold and open with a singular spirit; he admired the character of Sun Baigu, loved to associate with worthy men in court and country, and when conversation did not agree would chant poetry to disrupt it, and for this gained a reputation for eccentricity.
translations.idiomatic: He was forthright and spirited, admired the character of Sun Baigu, loved the company of worthy men in and out of office, and when talk did not suit him would break into verse to disrupt it, for which he gained a reputation as a eccentric.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，日本爭朝鮮，廷議出師，鍾祺上書請自效，遂從戎奉天。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu Japan contended over Korea; the court debated sending troops; Zhongqi memorialized offering himself and accordingly took the field at Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20, when Japan pressed its claim over Korea and the court debated dispatching troops, Zhongqi submitted a memorial offering his service and went to war in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 盛京將軍依克唐阿器之，使統鎮邊馬隊。

translations.literal: Shengjing general Yiketang'a valued his ability and had him command the border cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Shengjing General Yiketang'a recognized his talent and put him in command of the border cavalry.

sentences.zh: 會和議定，遂歸。

translations.literal: When peace was settled he returned.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was concluded he returned home.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，李秉衡奉旨巡視長江，親訪於家，疏請從行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Li Bingheng was ordered to inspect the Yangzi and visited him at home in person, memorializing to have him accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Li Bingheng was ordered to inspect the Yangzi, called on him at home, and memorialized the throne to take him along.

sentences.zh: 拳匪禍作，冒鋒火而北，秉衡殉難，鍾祺護其喪歸。

translations.literal: When the Boxer calamity arose he braved gunfire to go north; Bingheng died for the state and Zhongqi escorted his coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer disaster erupted he braved the fighting to go north; after Bingheng died in service Zhongqi escorted his coffin home.

sentences.zh: 歸三日，京師破，鍾祺自縊死。

translations.literal: Three days after his return the capital fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Three days after his return the capital fell, and Zhongqi hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 著五倫大義、馬氏日記若干卷。

translations.literal: He authored several volumes of The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary.
translations.idiomatic: He left several volumes, including The Great Meaning of the Five Relationships and the Ma Family Diary.

sentences.zh: 候選縣丞董瀚，於城破日與弟候補巡檢徵曰：「我等職雖微末，既讀聖賢書，惟有以身殉國而已。

translations.literal: Candidate assistant magistrate Dong Han, on the day the city fell said to his younger brother, candidate sub-prefectural inspector Zheng: "Though our offices are humble, having read the books of the sages we have only to give our bodies for the state."
translations.idiomatic: Candidate Assistant Magistrate Dong Han said to his younger brother, candidate sub-prefectural inspector Zheng, on the day the city fell: "Though our offices are humble, having read the sages we can do nothing but give our lives for the state."

sentences.zh: 」同時自縊。

translations.literal: " They hanged themselves at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: " They hanged themselves together.

sentences.zh: 涿州附生譚昌祺，聞城陷，懷藥哭諸聖廟，仰藥死。

translations.literal: Zhuozhou government student Tan Changqi, hearing that the city had fallen, carried poison, wept at the temple of the sages, and died by taking it.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Changqi, a government student of Zhuozhou, upon hearing that the city had fallen took poison with him, wept at the Confucian temple, and died by swallowing it.

sentences.zh: 舉人莊禮本，留京讀書。

translations.literal: Provincial graduate Zhuang Liben remained in the capital to study.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Graduate Zhuang Liben had remained in the capital to study.

sentences.zh: 拳匪初起，即以為憂。

translations.literal: When the Boxers first arose he was already troubled.
translations.idiomatic: From the first rise of the Boxers he was deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 洋兵入城，痛哭不食，後以一慟而絕。

translations.literal: When foreign soldiers entered the city he wept bitterly and would not eat, and later died in a single burst of grief.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign troops entered the city he wept bitterly and refused food, and later died in a single paroxysm of grief.

sentences.zh: 州同銜馮福疇，在通州署辦刑名事。

translations.literal: Feng Fuchou, with the rank of sub-prefect, was at the Tongzhou yamen handling criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Fuchou, who held the rank of sub-prefect, was handling criminal cases at the Tongzhou yamen.

sentences.zh: 七月十六日，敵入署，守護案牘，不屈，被戕。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month the enemy entered the yamen; he guarded the case records, would not submit, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the seventh month the enemy entered the yamen; he defended the archives, refused to yield, and was slain.

sentences.zh: 東城司吏目、練勇局委員宮玉森，洋兵攻局，其女請避，怒投其女於井，拔刀出戰。

translations.literal: Eastern City sub-prefectural inspector and drill corps commissioner Gong Yusen, when foreign soldiers attacked the bureau, his daughter asked to flee; in anger he threw his daughter into a well, drew his sword, and went out to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Yusen, sub-prefectural inspector of the Eastern City and commissioner of the drill corps, when foreign troops attacked the bureau and his daughter begged to flee, angrily cast her into a well, drew his sword, and went out to fight.

sentences.zh: 傷數處，自知不免，亦投井死。

translations.literal: Wounded in several places and knowing he could not escape, he also threw himself into the well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded in several places and knowing he could not escape, he too cast himself into the well and died.

sentences.zh: 時同被難者，為原品休緻禮部侍郎景善，前奉天府尹福裕，蒙古副都統耆齡，前察哈爾副都統明秀，冠軍使文琭，工科給事中恩順，刑部郎中汪以莊，兵部員外郎薩德賀、趙寶書，吏部主事鍾傑，戶部主事陶見曾、李慕、鐵山，刑部主事毛煥樞、王者馨，工部主事白慶、恆昌，理籓院主事英順，光祿寺署丞多文，國子監助教柏山，候選道鄭錫敞，前紹興府知府繼恩，分省知縣王朝鐀等，見冊報者千餘人。

translations.literal: At the time those who likewise met calamity included former vice president of rites Jingshan, who had retired at his original rank, former metropolitan prefect of Shuntian Fuyu, Mongol lieutenant general Qiling, former Chahar lieutenant general Mingxiu, champion commissioner Wen Yu, Ministry of Works supervising secretary Enshun, Ministry of Punishments director Wang Yizhuang, Ministry of War vice directors Sadehe and Zhao Baoshu, Ministry of Personnel secretary Zhong Jie, Ministry of Revenue secretaries Tao Jianzeng, Li Mu, and Tieshan, Ministry of Punishments secretaries Mao Huanshu and Wang Zhexin, Ministry of Works secretaries Bai Qing and Hengchang, Lifanyuan secretary Yingshun, acting vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Duowen, National University assistant instructor Baishan, candidate circuit intendant Zheng Xichang, former prefect of Shaoxing Ji'en, provincial magistrate Wang Chaojiong, and others; more than a thousand were reported in the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Those who perished at the same time included former Vice President of Rites Jingshan, who had retired at his original rank, former Metropolitan Prefect of Shuntian Fuyu, Mongol Lieutenant General Qiling, former Chahar Lieutenant General Mingxiu, Champion Commissioner Wen Yu, Supervising Secretary Enshun of the Ministry of Works, Director Wang Yizhuang of the Ministry of Punishments, Vice Directors Sadehe and Zhao Baoshu of the Ministry of War, Secretary Zhong Jie of the Ministry of Personnel, Secretaries Tao Jianzeng, Li Mu, and Tieshan of the Ministry of Revenue, Secretaries Mao Huanshu and Wang Zhexin of the Ministry of Punishments, Secretaries Bai Qing and Hengchang of the Ministry of Works, Lifanyuan Secretary Yingshun, Acting Vice Director Duowen of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, National University Assistant Instructor Baishan, Candidate Circuit Intendant Zheng Xichang, former Prefect of Shaoxing Ji'en, Provincial Magistrate Wang Chaojiong, and others; more than a thousand names appear in the official registers.

sentences.zh: 全家焚溺服毒自經以盡節者眾，騎都尉候選員外郎陳鑾，住東便門二閘，於七月十九日洋人攻城，勢急，與諸弟率眷屬僕婢三十二名，一時自盡，尤為慘烈雲。

translations.literal: Many whole families burned themselves, drowned, took poison, or hanged themselves to preserve their integrity; cavalry commandant and candidate vice director Chen Luan lived at the second lock of Dongbianmen; on the nineteenth day of the seventh month, when foreign soldiers attacked the city and the situation was desperate, he and his younger brothers led wives, children, servants, and maids, thirty-two persons in all, to die together at once, which was said to be especially tragic.
translations.idiomatic: Many families died together by fire, drowning, poison, or hanging to preserve their honor. Chen Luan, a cavalry commandant and candidate vice director who lived at the second lock of Dongbianmen, on the nineteenth day of the seventh month, as foreign troops pressed the assault, led his brothers, dependents, and servants—thirty-two people in all—to take their lives together at once, a death regarded as especially tragic.

sentences.zh: 宋春華，字實菴，陝西三原人。

translations.literal: Song Chunhua, style Shian, was a native of Sanyuan in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chunhua, styled Shian, was from Sanyuan in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 光緒十二年武進士，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: He became a military jinshi in the twelfth year of Guangxu and was appointed a blue-tassel bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military jinshi examination in Guangxu 12 and was appointed a blue-tassel bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 出為天津鎮標右營守備，與士卒共甘苦，所部為天津綠營冠。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as garrison commander of the Right Battalion of the Tianjin Brigade, shared hardship and comfort with his soldiers, and his command was the finest of the Tianjin Green Standard Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as garrison commander of the Right Battalion of the Tianjin Brigade, shared hardship and comfort with his men, and his unit was counted the best in the Tianjin Green Standard Army.

sentences.zh: 聯軍內犯，總督裕祿檄春華守城南門。

translations.literal: When the allied armies invaded inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to hold the south city gate.
translations.idiomatic: When the allied armies advanced inland, Governor Yulu ordered Chunhua to defend the south gate.

sentences.zh: 城東南製造軍械所不守，春華集其眾曰：「軍械所存亡，天津生死系之。

translations.literal: The ordnance factory southeast of the city was not being held; Chunhua gathered his troops and said: "Whether the ordnance factory stands or falls is bound up with the life and death of Tianjin."
translations.idiomatic: The ordnance factory southeast of the city was left undefended; Chunhua assembled his men and said, "Whether the arsenal stands or falls is a matter of life and death for Tianjin."

sentences.zh: 不奪歸不可，膽勇者盍隨吾出城！

translations.literal: We cannot fail to take it back; let the brave follow me out of the city!"
translations.idiomatic: We must retake it; let the brave follow me out of the city!"

sentences.zh: 」皆應曰：「諾！

translations.literal: " All answered: "Yes!"
translations.idiomatic: " All answered, "Yes!"

sentences.zh: 」率百餘人夜半潛出，及庫垣，春華先登，眾隨之。

translations.literal: " He led more than a hundred men out secretly at midnight; reaching the depot wall, Chunhua climbed first and the troops followed.
translations.idiomatic: " He led more than a hundred men out under cover of night; at the depot wall Chunhua climbed first and his men followed.

sentences.zh: 槍中春華左股，眾欲退，春華負創大呼曰：「今夕之事，有進無退！

translations.literal: A bullet struck Chunhua in the left thigh; the troops wished to withdraw, but Chunhua, bearing his wound, shouted: "Tonight's affair allows advance, not retreat!"
translations.idiomatic: A bullet struck Chunhua in the left thigh; his men wanted to pull back, but he, wounded, shouted, "Tonight we advance—we do not retreat!"

sentences.zh: 」眾爭奪敵，死傷甚眾，卒以守堅，退歸城。

translations.literal: " The troops strove to seize the enemy; many were killed and wounded; in the end, because the defenders held firm, they withdrew back to the city.
translations.idiomatic: " His men fought to seize the position; casualties were heavy, and in the end, as the defenders held firm, they withdrew back inside the walls.

sentences.zh: 已而敵兵日集，守土官多棄城走，春華慨語其妻陳曰：「城孤兵單，終恐不守。

translations.literal: Before long enemy troops gathered daily, and many territorial officials abandoned the city and fled; Chunhua said with emotion to his wife, Lady Chen: "The city is isolated and our forces few; in the end I fear it cannot be held."
translations.idiomatic: Before long the enemy gathered in strength, and many local officials abandoned the city and fled. Chunhua said earnestly to his wife Lady Chen, "The city is isolated and our forces are few; I fear in the end we cannot hold it."

sentences.zh: 汝當以吾子出求生，吾誓與城存亡矣！

translations.literal: You should take my son and go out to seek life; I swear to live or die with the city!"
translations.idiomatic: You must take our son and flee to safety; I swear to live or die with this city!"

sentences.zh: 」語畢，登陴督戰不少息。

translations.literal: " When he had finished speaking he mounted the battlements and directed the fighting without rest.
translations.idiomatic: " When he had finished speaking he mounted the walls and directed the fighting without pause.

sentences.zh: 城既陷，身被數傷，猶死守不​​退。

translations.literal: When the city had fallen he received many wounds but still held firm and would not withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: After the city fell he was wounded many times yet still held his ground and would not yield.

sentences.zh: 或勸少避，春華曰：「城不守，死自吾分。

translations.literal: Some urged him to withdraw a little; Chunhua said: "If the city is not held, death is my allotted portion."
translations.idiomatic: Some urged him to pull back slightly; Chunhua said, "If the city cannot be held, death is my portion alone."

sentences.zh: 汝曹各有父母妻子，歸可也，俱死無益！

translations.literal: You all have fathers and mothers, wives and children; you may go back; to die together would be of no use!"
translations.idiomatic: You all have parents, wives, and children—you may withdraw; to die together would serve no purpose!"

sentences.zh: 」眾感其義，無退者。

translations.literal: " The troops were moved by his righteousness, and none withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: " His men were moved by his example, and none retreated.

sentences.zh: 敵畢登城，乃仰天歎曰：「吾志不遂，負國恩矣！

translations.literal: When the enemy had all mounted the wall he looked up to heaven and sighed: "My purpose is not fulfilled; I have failed the state's grace!"
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy had fully taken the wall he looked up to heaven and sighed, "My purpose is unfulfilled; I have failed the grace of the state!"

sentences.zh: 然自接戰以來，殺敵過當，今日之死，亦無所恨。

translations.literal: Yet since we joined battle I have killed the enemy in excess; in dying today I have no regret."
translations.idiomatic: Yet since the fighting began I have killed more than my share of the enemy; in dying today I have no regret."

sentences.zh: 」以首觸陴，腦出，死，年三十五。

translations.literal: " He struck the parapet with his head; his brains burst forth, and he died at the age of thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: " He dashed his head against the parapet; his brains burst forth, and he died at the age of thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 馬福祿，字壽三，甘肅河州人。

translations.literal: Ma Fulu, style Shousan, was a native of Hezhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Fulu, styled Shousan, was from Hezhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年武進士，用衛守備，歸河南鎮標，以終養告歸。

translations.literal: He became a military jinshi in the sixth year of Guangxu, was appointed a garrison commandant, returned to the Henan Brigade, and requested leave to retire and care for his parents until their death.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the military jinshi examination in Guangxu 6, was appointed a garrison commandant, returned to the Henan Brigade, and later retired to observe mourning for his parents.

sentences.zh: 二十年，循化撒拉回族以爭教叛，固原提督雷正綰檄福祿往崔家峽、樊家峽協防，戰輒勝。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Salar Muslims of Xunhua rebelled over a dispute in religion; Gansu provincial commander Lei Zhengkuan ordered Fulu to assist in the defense of Cuijia Gorge and Fanjia Gorge, and in battle he always won.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 20 the Salar Muslims of Xunhua rebelled over a religious dispute; Provincial Commander Lei Zhengkuan of Guyuan ordered Fulu to help defend Cuijia Gorge and Fanjia Gorge, and he won every engagement.

sentences.zh: 河、湟回匪繼起，复助官兵獲大捷。

translations.literal: Muslim rebels in the He and Huang regions rose in succession, and he again aided the government troops to win a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Muslim rebels rose in succession along the He and Huang rivers, he again helped the government forces win a major victory.

sentences.zh: 累功至記名總兵。

translations.literal: By accumulated merit he rose to brevet major general.
translations.idiomatic: Through accumulated merit he rose to brevet major general.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河州諸回變，福祿本回教，回以福祿助官軍，欲加害。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the Muslims of Hezhou rose in revolt; Fulu was himself a Muslim, and the rebels, because Fulu aided the government army, wished to harm him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the Muslims of Hezhou rebelled. Fulu was himself a Muslim, and because he aided the government forces the rebels sought to kill him.

sentences.zh: 福祿在城，人亦以回教為疑，獨正綰信之。

translations.literal: Fulu was in the city, and the people also suspected him on account of his faith; only Zhengkuan trusted him.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu remained in the city, and others also suspected him because of his faith; only Zhengkuan trusted him.

sentences.zh: 時河州鎮總兵湯彥和遠駐起乍堡，命福祿率騎兵迎入河州城鎮之，彥和猶豫不果行，叛回週七十乃糾眾據山巔下擊。

translations.literal: At the time Hezhou Brigade major general Tang Yanhe was stationed far away at Qizhabao; he ordered Fulu to lead cavalry to welcome him into Hezhou city and pacify it, but Yanhe hesitated and did not go; the rebel Muslim Zhou Qishi then gathered a crowd, seized the mountain heights, and struck downward.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Major General Tang Yanhe of the Hezhou Brigade was encamped far away at Qizhabao. He ordered Fulu to lead cavalry to escort him into Hezhou and restore order, but Yanhe hesitated and never came. The rebel leader Zhou Qishi then rallied his followers on the heights and attacked from above.

sentences.zh: 福祿戰二日，以失地利無功。

translations.literal: Fulu fought for two days but, having lost the advantage of terrain, achieved nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu fought for two days but, having lost the advantage of terrain, gained nothing.

sentences.zh: 彥和復潛走，軍無統帥，賊益蹙之。

translations.literal: Yanhe again slipped away in secret; the army had no commander, and the rebels pressed them all the harder.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhe again slipped away in secret; the army was left without a commander, and the rebels pressed them harder still.

sentences.zh: 福祿乃突圍出南番境，至蘭州乞師。

translations.literal: Fulu then broke out of the encirclement into the southern frontier region and went to Lanzhou to beg for reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu then broke through the encirclement into the southern frontier and went to Lanzhou to seek reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 沿路拔出難民數千，難民德之，狀總督楊昌濬，昌濬以福祿孚眾望，乃檄與蘭州道黃雲由北路援河州。

translations.literal: Along the way he rescued several thousand refugees; the refugees were grateful to him and petitioned Governor Yang Changjun, who, because Fulu enjoyed the people's trust, ordered him and Lanzhou circuit intendant Huang Yun to relieve Hezhou by the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: Along the way he rescued several thousand refugees, who were grateful and petitioned Governor Yang Changjun. Yang, seeing that Fulu enjoyed the people's trust, ordered him and Lanzhou Circuit Intendant Huang Yun to relieve Hezhou by the northern route.

sentences.zh: 時喀什噶爾提督董福祥奉旨赴甘肅協剿，由狄道進兵。

translations.literal: At the time Kashgar commander Dong Fuxiang was ordered to go to Gansu to assist in the suppression and advanced by way of Didao.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Kashgar Commander Dong Fuxiang was ordered to Gansu to assist in the suppression and advanced by way of Didao.

sentences.zh: 福祿率師至蓮花渡，與賊隔岸相持，為福祥軍犄角，卒解河州圍。

translations.literal: Fulu led his army to Lianhua Ford and faced the rebels across the river; he served as a pincer for Fuxiang's army and in the end lifted the siege of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu led his troops to Lianhua Ford and faced the rebels across the river, forming a pincer with Fuxiang's army and ultimately lifting the siege of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 時韓文秀亦作亂，河湟提督李培榮、總兵牛師韓軍失利，陝西巡撫魏光燾與福祥會白塔寺，議進兵。

translations.literal: At the time Han Wenxiu also rebelled; He-Huang provincial commander Li Peirong and major general Niu Shihan's army suffered defeat; Shaanxi governor Wei Guangtao met Fuxiang at Baita Temple to discuss advancing the army.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Han Wenxiu also rebelled; Provincial Commander Li Peirong of the He-Huang region and Major General Niu Shihan suffered defeat; Shaanxi Governor Wei Guangtao met Fuxiang at Baita Temple to plan the advance.

sentences.zh: 福祿入謁，陳亂事顛末，及前後戰狀，福祥奇之，檄剿叛回冶主麻於米拉溝。

translations.literal: Fulu went in audience, set forth the course of the rebellion and the battles before and after; Fuxiang was impressed and ordered him to suppress the rebel Muslim Yezhuma at Mila Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: Fulu presented himself, recounted the course of the rebellion and the battles fought, and Fuxiang was impressed. He ordered him to suppress the rebel Yezhuma at Mila Gorge.

sentences.zh: 剿未盡，馬營土豪馬采哥應之，福祥部將石堯臣等告敗，福祿復分道往援，首先陷陣，斬採哥，聚而殲之。

translations.literal: The suppression was not complete when the local strongman Ma Caige of Macamp responded; Fuxiang's subordinate generals Shi Yaochan and others reported defeat; Fulu again divided his forces to go to their aid, was first to break the enemy line, beheaded Caige, gathered the enemy together, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: Before the campaign was finished the local strongman Ma Caige of Macamp rose in support; Fuxiang's generals Shi Yaochan and others reported defeat. Fulu again divided his forces to reinforce them, was first to break the enemy line, beheaded Caige, and annihilated the rebel band.

sentences.zh: 冶主麻收餘燼由黑山趨米拉，復還兵破之，斬無算，用是有驍將名。

translations.literal: Yezhuma gathered the embers of his force and went from Heishan toward Mila; Fulu turned his army back, defeated him, and beheaded untold numbers; by this he gained the name of a fierce general.
translations.idiomatic: Yezhuma gathered the remnants of his force and moved from Heishan toward Mila; Fulu turned back, defeated him, and slew untold numbers. From this he gained a reputation as a fierce general.

sentences.zh: 拳匪倡亂，福祥奉旨入都，檄福祿統馬步七營、旗防山海關，尋移永平府，福祥入衛京師，檄隨行。

translations.literal: When the Boxers began the uprising, Fuxiang was ordered to enter the capital and ordered Fulu to command seven battalions of horse and foot to guard Shanhaiguan with the banners; soon he was moved to Yongping Prefecture; when Fuxiang entered the capital to guard it he ordered Fulu to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxers rose in rebellion, Fuxiang was ordered to the capital and directed Fulu to command seven battalions of horse and foot to guard Shanhaiguan. He was soon transferred to Yongping Prefecture, and when Fuxiang entered the capital to guard it he ordered Fulu to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 五月，各國聯軍躪楊村而西，偕漢中鎮總兵姚旺等赴黃村御之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the allied armies of the powers overran Yangcun and advanced west; together with Hanzhong Brigade major general Yao Wang and others he went to Huangcun to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the allied armies overran Yangcun and advanced west; he went with Hanzhong Brigade Major General Yao Wang and others to Huangcun to resist them.

sentences.zh: 抵廊坊，​​兩軍相接，乃令騎兵下設七覆，步兵張兩翼，敵近始發槍，倒者如僕牆。

translations.literal: Reaching Langfang, the two armies met; he then ordered the cavalry to dismount and form seven lines in depth, the infantry to spread both wings, and guns to fire only when the enemy drew near; those who fell were like a toppled wall.
translations.idiomatic: At Langfang the two armies met. He ordered the cavalry to dismount and form seven ranks in depth, the infantry to extend both wings, and muskets to fire only when the enemy drew near; the fallen lay like a toppled wall.

sentences.zh: 敵彈落如雨，騎兵以散處少傷，兩翼左右复包抄其後，短兵相接，敵不支，遽卻，為庚子之役第一惡戰。

translations.literal: Enemy bullets fell like rain; the cavalry, being scattered, suffered few wounds; both wings then wheeled left and right to envelop the enemy's rear; at close quarters the enemy could not hold and quickly withdrew; this was the first fierce battle of the Gengzi campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Enemy bullets fell like rain; the cavalry, being dispersed, suffered few casualties; both wings then wheeled to envelop the enemy's rear. At close quarters the enemy gave way and quickly withdrew. This was the first fierce battle of the Boxer War of 1900.

sentences.zh: 六月，福祥檄令攻使館，中彈歿於陣，猶子耀圖、兆圖亦死，同殉者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an attack on the legations; struck by a bullet he died on the field; his nephews Yaotu and Zhaotu also died, and more than a hundred died with them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Fuxiang ordered an assault on the legation quarter; Fulu was struck by a bullet and died in battle, his nephews Yaotu and Zhaotu also perished, and more than a hundred died with them.

sentences.zh: 楊福同，直隸清苑人。

translations.literal: Yang Futong was a native of Qingyuan in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Futong was from Qingyuan in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，投軍，累擢游擊，從討朝陽教匪。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi he entered the army, was promoted in succession to brigade commander, and followed the campaign against the Chaoyang sect rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 he joined the army, rose in succession to brigade commander, and took part in the campaign against the Chaoyang sect rebels.

sentences.zh: 嗣以副將駐營大名，專力緝捕，以功記名總兵，分統練軍左翼馬隊，兼統天津馬步隊各營。

translations.literal: Later, as deputy general he was stationed at Daming, devoted himself wholly to pursuit and arrest, and by merit was brevetted major general, placed in command of the left wing cavalry of the drill army, and also given overall command of the various horse and foot battalions of Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as deputy general he was stationed at Daming and devoted himself to pursuit and arrest. By merit he was brevetted major general, placed in command of the left-wing cavalry of the drill army, and given overall command of the various horse and foot battalions at Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 近畿拳匪蜂起，淶水尤甚，總督裕祿檄福同率隊往。

translations.literal: Boxers swarmed up around the capital, especially in Laishui; Governor Yulu ordered Futong to lead a detachment there.
translations.idiomatic: Boxers swarmed up around the capital, especially in Laishui; Governor Yulu ordered Futong to lead a detachment there.

sentences.zh: 至史家莊，伏匪邀擊，力御之，擒數人。

translations.literal: Reaching Shijiazhuang, ambushing bandits intercepted him; he resisted them with force and captured several men.
translations.idiomatic: At Shijiazhuang ambushing bandits attacked him; he fought them off forcefully and captured several men.

sentences.zh: 次日，又敗匪於石亭鎮，擒首要梁修。

translations.literal: The next day he again defeated the bandits at Shiting Town and captured the ringleader Liang Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he defeated the bandits again at Shiting Town and captured the ringleader Liang Xiu.

sentences.zh: 福同不忍多誅，令限日解散，留馬隊三十人鎮之。

translations.literal: Futong could not bear to execute many; he ordered them to disperse within a set number of days and left thirty cavalrymen to keep order.
translations.idiomatic: Futong was unwilling to execute many; he ordered them to disperse within a set time and left thirty cavalrymen to keep order.

sentences.zh: 無何，匪以千餘眾攻留隊，福同率步兵數十馳援。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits attacked the remaining detachment with more than a thousand men; Futong led several dozen infantry in a rapid rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long more than a thousand bandits attacked the remaining detachment; Futong led several dozen infantrymen to their relief.

sentences.zh: 將及石亭，群匪自溝中突出，白刃交下，創甚，猶格殺數人，力盡死之。

translations.literal: As he was nearing Shiting, the bandits burst out of the ditches; blades crossed above him; he was badly wounded but still killed several men in hand-to-hand fighting and died when his strength was spent.
translations.idiomatic: As he neared Shiting the bandits burst from the ditches; blades rained down on him. Though badly wounded he still killed several men in hand-to-hand fighting and died when his strength gave out.

sentences.zh: 從弁孫裕清、盧興璠俱力戰死，賜卹如例。

translations.literal: His aides Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan also fought to the death; pensions were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: His aides Sun Yuqing and Lu Xingfan also fought to the death; pensions were granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 吳德潚，字筱村，四川達縣人。

translations.literal: Wu Desi, style Xiaocun, was a native of Daxian in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Desi, styled Xiaocun, was from Daxian in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 性至孝。

translations.literal: His nature was profoundly filial.
translations.idiomatic: He was profoundly filial by nature.

sentences.zh: 博極群書，以進士用知縣。

translations.literal: He mastered all the classics and, as a jinshi, was appointed magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He mastered the classics and, as a jinshi, was appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 庚子年，任浙江，西安、北京拳亂起，江山縣土匪以仇教為名，連陷江山、常山，縣人咸欲應之，德潚謂北事未定，洋人必不宜殲。

translations.literal: In the gengzi year he was serving in Zhejiang; the Boxer turmoil broke out in Xi'an and Beijing; bandits in Jiangshan County, under the name of opposing foreign religion, successively took Jiangshan and Changshan; the people of the county all wished to join them; Desi said the northern affair was not settled and foreigners must not be exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: In the gengzi year he was serving in Zhejiang when the Boxer uprising broke out in Xi'an and Beijing. Bandits in Jiangshan County, claiming to oppose foreign religion, seized Jiangshan and Changshan in succession, and the local people wished to join them. Desi said the northern crisis was not settled and that foreigners must not be exterminated.

sentences.zh: 有羅楠者，素健訟，德潚嘗嚴懲之，久含恨。

translations.literal: There was a man named Luo Nan who was skilled at litigation; Desi had once punished him severely, and he had long harbored resentment.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Luo Nan, who was skilled at litigation, had once been severely punished by Desi and had long harbored a grudge.

sentences.zh: 結都司週之德，挾眾指德潚袒洋教，劫德潚縛道署轅門，盡鑷鬚髮，以利刃攢刺，洞腹死，德潚罵不絕口。

translations.literal: He joined with commandant Zhou Zhide, led a crowd to accuse Desi of favoring foreign religion, seized Desi and bound him at the gate of the circuit yamen, plucked out all his beard and hair, stabbed him repeatedly with sharp blades until his belly was pierced through, and he died; Desi cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Commandant Zhou Zhide, led a mob to accuse Desi of favoring foreign religion, seized him and bound him at the gate of the circuit yamen, plucked out his beard and hair, stabbed him repeatedly until his belly was pierced through, and killed him; Desi cursed without cease.

sentences.zh: 子仲韜馳哭屍下，又殺之，併入縣署殺全家四十餘口。

translations.literal: His son Zhongtao rushed to weep beneath the corpse and was also killed; they then entered the county yamen and killed the entire family of more than forty persons.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhongtao rushed to weep over the body and was also killed; they then entered the county yamen and slaughtered the entire family of more than forty people.

sentences.zh: 事定，卹如例。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, pensions were granted according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: When order was restored, pensions were granted according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 成肇麟，江蘇華亭人。

translations.literal: Cheng Zhaolin was a native of Huating in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zhaolin was from Huating in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 父孺，諸生，列儒林傳。

translations.literal: His father Ru was a licentiate and is recorded in the Forest of Scholars.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ru was a licentiate recorded in the Forest of Scholars.

sentences.zh: 肇麟由舉人官直隸知縣，遷直隸州知州，署滄州靜海，補靈壽，所至有績。

translations.literal: Zhaolin, from provincial graduate rank, served as magistrate in Zhili, was transferred to prefect of Zhili Department, acted as magistrate of Jinghai in Cangzhou, was appointed to Lingshou, and wherever he went had achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaolin entered office as a provincial graduate and served as magistrate in Zhili, was transferred to prefect of Zhili Department, acted as magistrate of Jinghai in Cangzhou, and was appointed to Lingshou; wherever he served he achieved distinction.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十七年，京師和議梗，聯軍西上，覃及邑境，責供牲畜糗糧甚厲，肇麟壹弗應。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Guangxu peace talks in the capital were stalled; the allied armies advanced west; the trouble spread to his district; they demanded livestock and grain provisions with great severity, and Zhaolin would not respond at all.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 27 peace talks in the capital stalled, the allied armies advanced west, and the turmoil reached his district. They demanded livestock and provisions with great severity, and Zhaolin refused entirely.

sentences.zh: 俄而布政使廷雍檄至，令迎犒，肇麟自念：「不迎犒，無以全民命；

translations.literal: Soon a dispatch arrived from provincial administration commissioner Ting Yong ordering him to welcome and supply the troops; Zhaolin reflected: "If I do not welcome and supply them, I cannot preserve the lives of the people;"
translations.idiomatic: Soon a dispatch arrived from Provincial Administration Commissioner Ting Yong ordering him to welcome and supply the allied troops. Zhaolin reflected, "If I do not welcome and supply them, I cannot save the lives of the people;"

sentences.zh: 迎犒，則以中國臣子助攻君父；

translations.literal: "if I welcome and supply them, then as a subject of China I would be aiding the attack on my sovereign and father;"
translations.idiomatic: "yet if I welcome and supply them, as a subject of China I would be aiding an attack on my sovereign and father;"

sentences.zh: 事處兩難，守土之義無可避，惟有一死耳！

translations.literal: "the affair stands on both horns of a dilemma; the duty of one who holds the soil cannot be evaded; there is only death!"
translations.idiomatic: "the matter is impossible either way; the duty of one who holds the land cannot be evaded—there is only death!"

sentences.zh: 」乃繕遺牒遣人間道達府，媵之以詩曰：「屈體全民命，捐軀表素懷。

translations.literal: " He then drafted a final memorial and sent a man by a secret route to deliver it to the prefecture, appending a poem that read: "Bending my person to preserve the people's lives, giving my body to express my plain heart."
translations.idiomatic: " He drafted a final memorial and sent a man by a secret route to the prefecture, appending a poem: "Bending my person to save the people's lives, giving my body to express my steadfast heart."

sentences.zh: 」李鴻章狀死事以上，謂其能伸大義，降敕褒嘉，贈太僕寺卿，諡恭恪，予世職。

translations.literal: " Li Hongzhang memorialized his death to the throne, saying that he had been able to uphold the great principle; an edict praised and rewarded him, posthumously appointing him vice president of the Court of the Imperial Stud, giving him the posthumous title Gongke, and granting a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Hongzhang memorialized his death to the throne, saying that he had upheld the great principle. An edict praised and rewarded him, posthumously appointing him Vice President of the Court of the Imperial Stud, granting the posthumous title Gongke, and conferring a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 明年，允直督請，建直隸省城專祠。

translations.literal: The next year, acceding to the request of the Zhili governor-general, a special shrine was built for him in the provincial capital of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, at the request of the governor-general of Zhili, a special shrine was built for him in the provincial capital.
